cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. For the project report, my printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Implementation: second place. Identifying the blockage stays first.

confusable: Saving face alone could deny the error; D67 instead makes a new hierarchy from that error.
comparison: Retrospective printer credit differs from immediate cake distribution.
seedUse: Retain D67-b restart, blockage and stress-testing escalation as an exact ranking game under A unilateral authority.
